poc_plan: Week 1: Integration and baseline profiling — run representative prompt set, measure token latency, verify KV cache behaviour
Week 2: Load ramp tests — ramp to target sustained QPS (200 req/s) and peak bursts (600 req/s) with traffic mix: 70% chat, 20% embeddings, 10% reranking
Week 3: Soak and failure tests — 48h soak at 80% sustained, inject node failover, verify fallback to warm variants and SLA metrics; run model variant routing tests
Artifacts: timeline reports, graphs for p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization heatmaps, billing/cost estimate for reserved pool
acceptance_criteria: P95 latency for chat (short prompts < 128 tokens) <= 200ms end-to-end under sustained load (80% of target QPS)
Throughput: sustain 180-220 requests/sec mixed workload with <10% CPU/GPU queuing events
Soak: no >5min incident over 48h soak at 80% capacity; failing node recovery <3 minutes with automatic reroute
Embeddings throughput: 50-100 reqs/sec for 2048-dim model with median latency <300ms
Operational: audit log entries for all inference requests available in console with retention controls enabled
representative_prompts: Chat — operator support: 'Telemetry stream #42 shows a drift in thermal sensor X. Summarize likely root causes and next checks.'
Summarization — post-pass analysis: 'Summarize last 10 minutes of telemetry anomalies and link to incident IDs.'
Embedding — similarity search: 'Return top 5 historical incidents similar to current sensor vector (vector provided).',
Reranking — log triage: 'Rank these 20 anomaly detections by likely severity using log context.'
Long-context streaming — transcript distillation: 'Ingest 8k-token mission log, produce executive summary and action items.'
